concept.zh: 严格递增子序列的长度与条数
concept.en: Length and count of strictly rising subsequences

brief.zh: 按 heights 的原顺序选若干根天线，每根都要比刚选的上一根高，可以跳过。返回 [最多能选几根, 达到这个长度的选法数]。只要选中的位置不同就算另一种选法。没有天线时返回 [0, 0]。
brief.en: Select antennas in their original order from heights. You may skip some, but each selected antenna must be taller than the last. Return [maximum number selected, number of ways to reach that length]. Different positions give different choices. Return [0, 0] for an empty row.
